noun_definition: web refers to the online platform where users can manage their account settings, specifically in relation to inputting personal details such as a legal name.
Account settings refers to the section within the web application where users can manage their personal information, including the legal name, which is expected to accept only Latin characters.
Error message refers to the notification that should inform the user to enter a name using Latin characters when they attempt to input a Legal name with non-English alphabet letters.
Legal name refers to the official name of an individual as required in the account settings, which in this context is expected to be entered using Latin characters.
Non-english alphabet refers to any writing system that does not use Latin characters, such as the Cyrillic alphabet used in the example provided.
